about: A JavaScript library that reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files and pulls out their text.

prs.title: Formula results in Excel show the & sign as written
prs.broken: Text produced by a formula in an Excel sheet came out with codes like & instead of the & sign, while other cells were fine.
prs.changed: Formula text results are now decoded the same way as other cell text.
prs.matters: Text pulled from spreadsheets, like a company name AT&T, now reads correctly.

prs.title: Excel files made by .NET tools are read
prs.broken: Excel files written by Microsoft's .NET Open XML toolkit came back as one empty sheet, with no warning.
prs.changed: The parser now understands the naming style these files use and reads their sheets, rows and text.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets produced by many business apps no longer turn up empty.
